name: SU8
comment: Negative epoxy photoresist SU-8 (MRT, Germany). Neustroeva 2021, sec. 1.7; Neustroeva 2019, sec. 5.2 (ref. [11] there: Reznikova et al., Phys. Stat. Sol. (a) 204 (2007) 2811).
mass_percent_note: Published values sum to 100.1173 %; they are normalised by this sum when building the G4Material (relative change 1.2e-3).

delta.source: delta(25 keV) = 4.32e-7 (Neustroeva 2019/2021); delta ~ lambda^2 = E^-2 as in thesis formula (1.7.4) delta = 1.7564e-6 lambda[A]^2 (identical to 4 digits). Approximation valid far from absorption edges; NOT valid near the Sb K edge (30.49 keV).

beta_note: Not used in stage 1. Thesis value mu = 0.66 1/m at 25 keV is inconsistent with beta: 4 pi beta / lambda = 66.1 1/m = 0.661 1/cm, and mu_m rho = 0.543 cm2/g * 1.24 g/cm3 = 0.673 1/cm; the unit must be 1/cm.
